value.rationale: The sharp universal macroscopic two-colour Poisson error is approximately 0.533230687960, strictly above the parity-only obstruction 1/2, with a unique balanced extremizer. Correcting parity still leaves a sharp universal error approximately 0.166064074983. These complete one-parameter profiles distinguish the structural support failure from intrinsic variance mismatch and supply quantitative benchmarks for natural fixed-point approximations, not just a generic qualitative negative check.
